mapper.select: SELECT TOP (#{limit}) CONVERT(varchar(128),[AccountId]) AS [source_key], LTRIM(RTRIM([AccountNumber])) AS [code], LTRIM(RTRIM([erpCustomerCode])) AS [erp_customer_code], LTRIM(RTRIM([Name])) AS [name], LTRIM(RTRIM([Telephone1])) AS [contact_phone], LTRIM(RTRIM([EMailAddress1])) AS [contact_email], LTRIM(RTRIM([Address1_Composite])) AS [address], CONVERT(varchar(128),[new_mkt_unit_id]) AS [department_code], LTRIM(RTRIM([new_mkt_unit_idName])) AS [department_name], CONVERT(varchar(128),[new_industry_level1_id]) AS [market_code], LTRIM(RTRIM([new_industry_level1_idName])) AS [market_name], CONVERT(varchar(128),[new_industry_level2_id]) AS [system_code], LTRIM(RTRIM([new_industry_level2_idName])) AS [system_name], CONVERT(varchar(128),[new_industry_level3_id]) AS [expend_code], LTRIM(RTRIM([new_industry_level3_idName])) AS [expend_name], CONVERT(varchar(128),[new_industry_level4_id]) AS [industry_code], LTRIM(RTRIM([new_industry_level4_idName])) AS [industry_name], CASE StateCode WHEN 0 THEN 'ENABLED' WHEN 1 THEN 'DISABLED' ELSE NULL END AS lifecycle_status, CONVERT(varchar(33),ModifiedOn,126) AS source_version, ModifiedOn AS data_as_of, CASE WHEN Name IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(Name))='' THEN 'MISSING_CUSTOMER_NAME' WHEN LEN(Name)>128 THEN 'CUSTOMER_NAME_TOO_LONG' WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY LTRIM(RTRIM(AccountNumber)))>1 THEN 'DUPLICATE_CUSTOMER_CODE' ELSE NULL END AS migration_issue FROM DPtech_v_account ORDER BY AccountId
